downloadIntro.zh: Mac 与 Windows 版均已更新至 v1.59.82，Mac 版现提供 Apple 芯片与 Intel 芯片两个安装包。请选择与你的电脑匹配的安装包。
downloadIntro.en: Mac and Windows are now v1.59.82, and Mac now comes in Apple silicon and Intel builds. Choose the installer that matches your computer.

summary.zh: 适用于常见的 Intel 与 AMD 电脑，提供标准安装程序。
summary.en: For common Intel and AMD PCs, delivered as a standard installer.

summary.zh: 适用于 Apple 芯片与 Intel 芯片的 Mac，以 DMG 磁盘映像安装。
summary.en: For Apple silicon and Intel Macs, delivered as a DMG disk image.

highlights.zh: K线收线倒计时可以显示在价格线旁：每个图表窗格在最新价标签左边显示自己周期的倒计时，多个窗格看不同周期时各看各的。在图表显示菜单或「设置 → 图表」里选「关 / 工具栏 / 价格线」，原来的开关自动换成对应选项，默认仍为关。
highlights.en: The candle close countdown can sit beside the price line: each chart pane shows its own timeframe's countdown next to the last-price label, so panes on different timeframes each show their own. Choose Off / Toolbar / Last price line in the chart display menu or Settings → Chart; the old switch carries over, and the default stays Off.
